class.name: Horde2D
class.brief_description: Simulates and draws thousands of lightweight 2D agents that chase a target.

method.name: add_obstacle
method.description: Adds a static circular obstacle that agents cannot enter, and returns its index. Agents slide around obstacles but have no pathfinding, so a large obstacle between an agent and the target can block it.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every agent immediately. Their ids become stale and no [signal agents_died] is emitted for them; deaths that happened before the call are still reported on the next update.

method.name: clear_obstacles
method.description: Removes all obstacles added with [method add_obstacle].

method.name: damage
method.description: Subtracts [param amount] hit points from the agent [param id] and kills it when its hit points reach [code]0[/code] or below. A negative [param amount] heals, up to [member HordeType.max_hp]. Returns [code]false[/code] if the id is stale or invalid.

method.name: damage_circle
method.description: Damages every living agent whose body overlaps the circle at [param center] with [param radius] (distance between centers [code]<=[/code] [param radius] + agent radius) and returns their ids, including the ones that died. Killed agents are reported by [signal agents_died] on the next update.

method.name: get_agent_count
method.description: Returns the number of living agents.

method.name: get_agent_hp
method.description: Returns the current hit points of the agent [param id], or [code]0.0[/code] if the id is stale or invalid.

method.name: get_agent_position
method.description: Returns the position of the agent [param id] in local coordinates, or [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code] if the id is stale or invalid (use [method is_agent_alive] to tell them apart).

method.name: get_agent_type
method.description: Returns the [HordeType] of the agent [param id], or [code]null[/code] if the id is stale or invalid.

method.name: get_agent_velocity
method.description: Returns the velocity of the agent [param id] in pixels per second, or [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code] if the id is stale or invalid.

method.name: get_debug_stats
method.description: Returns counters and timings of the last update, also shown by [code]HordeDebugOverlay[/code]: - [code]agents[/code], [code]types[/code], [code]obstacles[/code]: current counts. - [code]cell_size[/code]: spatial hash cell size in use, in pixels. - [code]substeps[/code]: simulation steps run by the last update (see [member fixed_timestep]). - [code]neighbor_checks[/code]: agent pairs tested in the last step. - [code]hash_rebuilds[/code]: spatial hash rebuilds since the node was created. - [code]sim_usec[/code], [code]render_usec[/code], [code]update_usec[/code]: microseconds spent simulating, writing the [MultiMesh] buffers, and in the whole update. - [code]deaths_emitted[/code], [code]contacts[/code]: sizes of the last [signal agents_died] and [signal target_contact] batches.

method.name: is_agent_alive
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param id] refers to a living agent.

method.name: kill
method.description: Kills the agent [param id]. Its id is stale immediately and the death is reported by [signal agents_died] on the next update. Returns [code]false[/code] if the id is stale or invalid.

method.name: query_circle
method.description: Returns the ids of the living agents whose body overlaps the circle at [param center] with [param radius] (distance between centers [code]<=[/code] [param radius] + agent radius). The order is unspecified. Uses the spatial hash, so small queries are cheap even with many agents.

method.name: spawn
method.description: Spawns [param count] agents of [param type] at [param position] and returns their ids. When [param count] is greater than 1 they are scattered in a disc around [param position] large enough to avoid heavy overlap. Returns fewer ids if the agent limit (1,048,576) is reached or the position is not finite.

method.name: spawn_ring
method.description: Spawns [param count] agents of [param type] evenly spaced on a circle of [param radius] around [param center], starting at a random angle, and returns their ids.

method.name: step
method.description: Advances the simulation by [param delta] seconds (in whole steps of [member fixed_timestep] if it is set), redraws the agents and emits the update's signals. Called automatically unless [member update_mode] is [constant UPDATE_MANUAL].

members.member: Rectangle, in local coordinates, that agents cannot leave when [member bounds_enabled] is [code]true[/code]. Agents stay inside it by at least their radius.
If [code]true[/code], agents are kept inside [member bounds].

Size of the spatial hash cells in pixels. [code]0[/code] (default) uses twice the largest [member HordeType.radius], which suits most hordes. Values that would need searching more than 4 cells away are raised automatically.
If [code]true[/code], draws the bounds, obstacles, target radius and (with [member debug_draw_grid]) the spatial hash grid around the agents. Meant for debugging.
If [code]true[/code] and [member debug_draw] is enabled, also draws the spatial hash grid. Large grids are skipped.

If greater than [code]0[/code], each update runs as many whole simulation steps of this many seconds as the elapsed time allows (up to [member max_substeps]), which makes results independent of the frame rate and reproducible with the same [member seed] and inputs. [code]0[/code] (default) runs exactly one step per update using the frame's delta.
If [code]true[/code] and [member fixed_timestep] is set, agents are drawn between their previous and current simulated positions so movement stays smooth when the frame rate and the timestep differ.
Maximum number of [member fixed_timestep] steps per update. If the game falls further behind, the extra time is dropped instead of making the next frames even slower.

Fraction of the overlap between two agents that is removed at each step by pushing them apart, from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code]. Of each pair, the agent farther from the target moves more, so a crowd stays packed around the target instead of collapsing onto it. [code]0[/code] leaves only the softer separation steering.

Seed of the random numbers used when spawning (scatter positions, ring start angle, animation frame offsets). Setting it restarts the sequence. Together with [member fixed_timestep] or [constant UPDATE_MANUAL] with constant deltas, the same seed and the same calls in the same order give identical results on the same build.
The node agents chase, read every update. Its global position is converted to this node's local coordinates. If [code]null[/code] or outside the scene tree, [member target_position] is used instead.
Position agents chase, in local coordinates, when [member target] is not set.

Radius of the target in pixels. Agents within [code]target_radius + agent radius + 1[/code] pixels are reported by [signal target_contact], and with [member target_solid] they cannot get closer than [code]target_radius + agent radius[/code]. [code]0[/code] disables both.
If [code]true[/code], agents cannot enter the target's circle (see [member target_radius]) and press around it instead.
When the simulation advances. See [enum UpdateMode].

signal.name: agents_died
signal.description: Emitted once per update with every agent that died since the previous emission ([method kill], [method damage], [method damage_circle]), with their last positions in local coordinates. Their ids are already stale. Not emitted for agents removed by [method clear].

signal.name: target_contact
signal.description: Emitted once per update with the ids of the agents touching the target (see [member target_radius]). Agents that stay in contact are reported again on every update, so apply your own cooldown if needed.

constants.constant: The simulation advances once per rendered frame, in [method Node._process].
The simulation advances once per physics tick, in [method Node._physics_process]. Agents are drawn at physics rate, without interpolation.
The simulation only advances when [method step] is called.
